core_scoring_policy.notes: Only core server-side keys are allowed to support operational scoring inputs. Optional exploratory keys may unlock UI lookups but must not directly drive TULIP scoring.

keys.name: EIA API Key
keys.notes: Used to collect U.S. electricity-system baselines and annual operational context.

keys.name: Electricity Maps API Key
keys.notes: Used only to freeze snapshot data into static annualized context; not used as a live short-cycle feed.

keys.name: OpenAQ API Key
keys.notes: Optional convenience key for station lookups in the UI. It does not drive anchor calibration or TULIP scoring.

keys.name: ECMWF/CDS Key
keys.notes: Optional browser-stored key for generating dataset snippets only; it is not part of the scoring pipeline.

keys.name: USGS Water Data API Key
keys.notes: Optional server-side key for higher USGS OGC API rate limits. Snapshot observations remain evidence inputs until station and basin baselines are approved.

retired_or_excluded.reason: Removed from the current audited stack because the product decision is to avoid short-cycle marginal-emissions feeds and 30-minute credential refresh workflows.
